texts.zh:
我们位于[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上空的观测站在[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]的地表发现了一个非法定居点。可能是某些[Root.GetSpeciesName]走私贩或者[Root.GetName]的不法分子设立的哨站。

由于这些走私犯有时候会撞见当地的[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]，这里已经发生了一些零星的事故——某些事故甚至还上升到了暴力行为。我们需要尽快行动，在不法分子造成更大损失之前带走他们。
texts.en:
Our observation post above [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has detected an illegal settlement on the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]'s surface. It appears to be some kind of outpost set up by [Root.GetSpeciesName] smugglers and other criminal elements from the [Root.GetName].

There have already been isolated incidents where the smugglers came into contact with the native [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] - some of which ended in violence. We need to act quickly to contain this situation and remove the criminals before they can cause any more damage.

texts.zh: 走私贩们在[From.GetName]地表设立了一个非法哨站，这是一个受到我们保护的土著庇护所星球。必须在他们的行为对[From.GetPlanetMoon]的本土文明造成更大的危害前消除掉这个隐患。
texts.en: Smugglers have established an illegal outpost on the surface of [From.GetName], a primitive sanctuary world under our protection. They must be removed before they cause lasting harm to the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s native civilization.

texts.zh:
在一次闪电般的突袭行动中，我们的地面部队对[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的走私贩哨站发动了突击。在短暂的交火之后，幸存的罪犯们被逮捕并转运至轨道上。随后我们通过引爆炸药将这座空荡荡的建筑从地面抹除。

我们相信尽可能地将文化污染降到了最低，我们的部队也没收了大量的违禁品。没收所得的利润全部上交国库。
texts.en:
In a lightning raid, our ground forces stormed the smuggler outpost on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]. After a brief firefight, the surviving criminals were arrested and transported into orbit. The empty building was then vaporized by demolition charges.

Cultural contamination is believed to have been minimal, and our forces also confiscated a large amount of illegal contraband. The profits from this seizure have been added to our treasury.

texts.zh:
为时已晚。[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的走私贩已经开始用先进武器和粗制滥造的致幻兴奋剂同当地[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]换取贵金属和奴隶。

多个[GetPreFTLLower]群体之间爆发了战斗。由于高科技武器在手，双方人员伤亡惨重。事态发展至此，文化污染造成的恶果已经无法挽回。
texts.en:
We are too late. The smugglers on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have begun trading modern weapons and crude narcotic stimulants to the local [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] in exchange for precious metals and slaves.

Fighting has broken out between various [GetPreFTLLower] groups. Due to the high tech weaponry now at their disposal, casualties on both sides have been horrific. The cultural contamination is irreversible at this point.
